info.name: Weavr Multi Product BackOffice Access Token Card Payments API

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset value for paging, indicating the initial item number to be returned from the data set satisfying the given criteria. Leave out to fetch the first page of results.

params.name: limit
params.description: The limit of the results for paging, starting at the offset. Limit is always capped at 100.

params.name: cardId
params.description: Filter by the managed card the payment belongs to.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by one or more card payment statuses.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by one or more card payment types.

params.name: subtype
params.description: Filter by one or more event subtypes (joined against the events timeline).

params.name: merchantName
params.description: Partial, case-insensitive match against merchant name.

params.name: amountFrom
params.description: Filter for `displayAmount.amount >= amountFrom`.

params.name: amountTo
params.description: Filter for `displayAmount.amount <= amountTo`.

params.name: relatedCardPaymentId
params.description: Filter for card payments related to the given parent id.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Sort order on `creationTimestamp`. ASC = oldest first.

items.docs: Returns the aggregated card payments for the logged-in identity. A CardPayment represents the full lifecycle of a card payment (authorisation + settlements + optional reversal/expiry/refund/original credit) as a single business-level entity.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of a card payment.

items.docs: Returns a single card payment by id.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset value for paging, indicating the initial item number to be returned from the data set satisfying the given criteria. Leave out to fetch the first page of results.

params.name: limit
params.description: The limit of the results for paging, starting at the offset. Limit is always capped at 100.

params.name: cardPaymentId
params.description: Filter events to a single card payment.

params.name: cardId
params.description: Filter events to those on a single managed card.

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by one or more event types.

params.name: subtype
params.description: Filter events by one or more network subtypes.

params.name: reversal
params.description: Filter events by reversal flag.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Sort order on event timestamp. ASC = oldest first (default DESC).

items.docs: Returns a flat, chronological list of card payment events across one or more card payments. Each entry carries the event plus the parent CardPayment context (card, merchant, group).
